17)mkha' 'gro'i thugs tig las:phung po mchod sbyin tshogs gnyis chu gter bzhugs:na mo dz+nyā na ḍā ki ye:rnal 'byor lam gyi tshogs rdzogs phyiraḥsgyu lu

tei:div.tei:p: mkha' 'gro'i thugs tig las: phung po mchod sbyin tshogs gnyis chu gter bzhugs: na mo dz+nyā na ḍā ki ye: rnal 'byor lam gyi tshogs rdzogs phyiraḥ sgyu lus mchod sbyin 'di bstan bya: sa ma ya: phaṭaḥ skyabs gnas dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi: 'gro rnams byang chub thob phyir byang sems bskyed: phaṭaḥ rang lus che tsho snum brjid ldan pa gyur: lus dbus dbu ma mtshan nyid bzhi ldan sbubs: snying gar rlung sems 'dus pa'i thig le bsgom: phaṭaḥbarjod spyi bo nas thon nam mkhar spar: phaṭaḥphaṭaḥphaṭaḥ dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med khros mar bzhengs: phyag g.yas gri gug bem por tshad tsam gyis: sha khrag rus pa thar gyis zhig pa las: rang byung thod snod yangs shing rgya che'i nang: ngo bo bde stong ye shes bdud rtsi la: rnam pa phyi nang mchod pa'i sprin du spel: oṃ āḥhūm̐: phaṭaḥ dkon mchog rtsa gsum dam can rgya mtsho mchod: mnyes tshims bdag gzhan tshogs rdzogs sgrib dag shog: phaṭaḥ rigs drug pha ma lan chags mgron la bsngo: thams cad ngoms shing sdug bsngal kun bral nas: 18)srid pa'i mtsho las 'gro rnams sgrol bar shog: phaṭaḥ bdag dang snang ba gnyis med 'od gsal klong: sgyu ma'i 'phrul 'khor dbyings su zhig pa ltar: yum chen chos sku'i dgongs pa'i dbyings su a: phaṭaḥphaṭaḥphaṭaḥ ces brjod 'khor gsum yongs dag chen pos rgyas gdab par bya'o: ces pa dbon dz+nyā na'i mtshan can gyis nan cher bskul ngo mi ldog tsam du dhi paṃ tā res nyams chos yig ris su bris pa'o// dge'o//
